needed.evidence: The entire left side of the road is a wide, snow-covered verge with no defined or usable footway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, snow-cleared footway on the left side of the road, separated from the carriageway by a physical barrier.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the bus stop and shops on the right, but no marked or signalised crossing is present.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at the location of the bus stop to provide a safe and legal place for pedestrians to cross.
